blocker_recorded: Functional variant binding is deferred: the index projects PN, while the sourced default is SS34 Schottky. No MURS PN reference is verified; source function and model must not be silently interchanged.
blocker_resolution: Cannot be closed honestly. The only opened document (Vishay SS32-SS36) is a Schottky rectifier; binding SS34 under BEH-DIO-PN would assign a PN junction model to a Schottky part, and netlist.validate_reference_function refuses a recipe whose class (BEH-DIO-SCHOTTKY) is not in the entry's behavior_class_ids (only BEH-DIO-PN). The S2M precedent (OHM-065) does not transfer: there the spec named an S2x PN alternative and S2M's own datasheet was opened. Here the spec names only 'MURS-type' with no MPN and no voltage grade, and no MURS document is archived; choosing a grade (e.g. MURS320 vs MURS360) is a product decision, not evidence. Two honest paths, both needing a human decision: (a) add BEH-DIO-SCHOTTKY to OHM-066's class list (the spec section header lists PN, SCHOTTKY and TVS for OHM-066 but the index row projects PN only, which is a spec inconsistency) and bind SS34 as a Schottky; or (b) name an exact MURS3xx MPN, archive its manufacturer PDF, fit IS/N/RS to its curve, then bind it as an explicit PN alternative like S2M.
pin_map_evidence: Not reached. (SS34 SMC pin map K=1 band end, A=2 is consistent with the spec, but the function binding is the blocker.)

blocker_recorded: The available BAV99 power/thermal rating is explicitly for one diode loaded. Shared-package loading and configuration require a scoped runtime guard; no independent per-die power allocation is assumed.
blocker_resolution: The evidence needed for the guard is already in the BAV99 sheet (archived 826c982f): IF 215 mA single diode loaded, 125 mA per diode double diode loaded (p3 Table 5), Ptot 250 mW and Rth(j-a) 500 K/W both stated only for 'one diode loaded' (p3 Tables 5/6). Closing the blocker is therefore code, not research: bind only the BAV99 series configuration as one three-terminal instance, and add a dual-diode branch in behavior/ratings.py: per junction i <= if_single when the other junction's forward current is ~0, i <= if_double for each junction when both conduct; package power <= p_tot and Tamb+rth_ja*P <= tj_max evaluated ONLY in the one-diode-loaded state; with both loaded the package thermal check stays 'unknown: no source rating for both diodes loaded' (not pass, not zero heating). The existing BEH-DIO-PN rating branch reads v_A/v_K/i_A, which do not exist for roles A1/K2/K1/A2, so without the new branch every diode rating would silently be absent. BAV70/BAW56 are not bound (each has its own sourced values; BAW56 90 V / 2 pF). Electrical model: the spec's own instruction for OHM-070 (fit A 1N4148-class proxy with BAV99 Cd 1.5 pF) is used as an explicit proxy, checked against BAV99's own VF maximum.

blocker_recorded: Physical role binding remains unverified for the generic WOM/WOG combined entry.
blocker_resolution: Scope the binding to Vishay W10G only (DF10M precedent, D031); MCC WOM stays unbound. The Vishay WOG outline (doc 88769 p3, inspected image) marks '+' and '-' on one diagonal of the square lead pattern and the two '~' on the other diagonal, with equal 4.6-5.6 mm spacing on both axes. Every rotation or mirror of a square maps diagonals to diagonals, so the unresolved top-view/lead-end-view transform can only exchange which AC lead is library pin 2 vs 4. The library anchors pin 1 to the '+' lead (3D spec OHM-072 'OHMNI default pin 1 = +'), so PLUS=1 and MINUS=3 (diagonal) are fixed, and AC1/AC2 are electrically interchangeable in the four-identical-diode model; the existing bridge probe already tests both AC polarities. Hence the transform does not need to be proven for the electrical binding. Second problem found: with the class proxy card (IS 1.04e-10, N 1.8, RS 0.03) a W10G diode drops ~1.09 V at 1 A, above the W10G 1.0 V maximum, so the bridge probe (2*vf_max = 2.0 V) would fail; a W10G-specific forward fit from its own Fig. 3 is proposed (two-junction drop 1.895 V, passes).

blocker_recorded: Junction-to-solderpoint data does not establish a board/heatsink-to-ambient path; the85 C fit and revised source require explicit thermal-context handling before rated runtime use.
blocker_resolution: Handled by never using an ambient path: the rating guard is referenced to the solder point, which the caller must supply. Source facts (archived Cree CLD-DS56 Rev 25B): RthJS 5.8 C/W white (p3), Tj max 150 C (p4), IF max 1500 mA, VR 1 V (p3), VF 2.84 typ / 3.1 max at 350 mA and 85 C (p4), center pad electrically isolated, cathode left/anode right in top view (p38, viewed). Thermal context: rating check Tsp + rth_js*P_electrical <= tj_max with Tsp = RatingContext.case_c and thermal_scope_confirmed; all electrical power is counted as heat (conservative, since the optical fraction 'eta' is an ASSUMPTION); without Tsp the check is unknown. The 85 C issue: white VF is published only at Tj 85 C and the class card has TNOM=85, but compile_circuit always runs .temp 25. At 25 C the card gives 3.101 V at 350 mA, which is not comparable with an 85 C maximum. The binding pins the diode instance to the sourced binning junction temperature (instance temp from a sourced field), so the probe compares like with like: 2.9077 V at 350 mA, 85 C vs 3.1 V max. This is an isothermal-85 C electrical binding, stated as such. Requires two code additions (new probe and a BEH-LED-POWER rating branch).

limitations: Only onsemi 2N3904 is bound; PN2222A, BC546/547 (C-B-E) and other TO-92 functions are not substituted.

Q2N3904_R6FIT is the spec's Gummel-Poon fit to datasheet min/max bands (geometric-mean hFE targets, assumed VAF/BR/XTB/XTI), not a vendor model; the onsemi Rev 9 table gives an hFE maximum only at 10 mA.

blocker_recorded: Default MMBT3904/2N3904 fit is not established by the opened BC817 alternative; exact reference/model/pin binding is missing.
blocker_resolution: Honest as an explicit alternative, like S2M/BAT42W: the spec's own OHM-094 binding table lists BC817 (pins B-E-C, source S4, verified) next to the unverified MMBT3904 default, and the BC817 sheet is archived (dbbbeafc). The recipe binds BC817 by name and does not claim to model MMBT3904 or reuse the 2N3904 fit; the MMBT3904 default remains unbound (no onsemi/Nexperia MMBT3904 document is archived). Gain group: the reference stays 'BC817' with the sheet's ungraded row (hFE 100-600 at VCE 1 V, IC 100 mA), matching the existing reference_part field; a suffixed grade would need its own binding. Model per the class rule for BC817 ('use DERIVED BF = geometric mean of bin, IS = 1e-14, status partial'): BF = sqrt(100*600) = 244.95, IS quoted as an ASSUMPTION because the BC817 sheet has no non-saturated VBE-IC curve to fit (only VBEsat, Figs 5/9/13).

blocker_recorded: Default AMS1117-3.3 regulator remains unbound; BCP56 transistor research cannot supply its electrical truth. Regulator binding is deferred to the IC stage.
blocker_resolution: The blocker is correct for the regulator and stays true for it, but it does not prevent an honest BJT binding: the entry's only behavior class is BEH-TRN-BJT and the spec's OHM-096 binding table lists BCP56 (B-C-E-C, S5, verified) as a functional part beside the regulators. Binding BCP56 by name as an explicit alternative (exact precedent: OHM-095 BCX56 in the SOT-89 transistor/regulator entry, simulable with 'Regulator variants ... not bound by this recipe') leaves the AMS1117 default unbound and models nothing about it. The regulator default belongs to BEH-REG-LINEAR, which is not in this entry's class list, so it can only be bound in the IC stage (and AMS1117 has no archived source; TI LM1117 is archived). Model: BF = sqrt(63*250) = 125.5 from the ungraded hFE row, IS fitted from BCP56's own Fig. 7 VBE-IC curve at 25 C (7.3e-14 A, N 0.998 over 0.1-20 mA), consistent with the BCX56 fit (7.4e-14) on the same die family.

new_field_updates.detail: Vector polyline of Fig. 7 'Base-emitter voltage as a function of collector current; typical values' curve (2) Tamb = 25 °C, calibrated on gridlines (32.0 pt/decade, 0.4 V per 53.335 pt): e.g. 0.105 mA 0.5407 V, 1.25 mA 0.6064 V, 10.1 mA 0.6585 V, 20.2 mA 0.6776 V. Log fit 59.0 mV/decade (N = 0.998, so N = 1 used); IS = IC/exp(VBE/Vt) at 298.15 K gives 6.96e-14..7.82e-14, geometric mean 7.33e-14. Points above ~0.1 A (high injection/RB) excluded. Figure is for the 'BCP56 series', not a single gain group.

blocker_recorded: The default regulator has no re-verified source/functional binding; keep that default blocked.
blocker_resolution: The regulator default (ST L7805 D2PAK, BEH-REG-LINEAR) stays blocked, and the ST L78 sheet now archived (ccba643d) cannot change that inside this entry because BEH-REG-LINEAR is not in OHM-101's class list. But the entry's only class is BEH-TRN-MOSFET, the spec's OHM-101 table has a 'power MOSFETs in D2PAK, G-D-S' row that was research_required only because no D2PAK MOSFET sheet had been opened, and IRFZ44NS (D2PAK, archived 6fcd0535) now supplies ratings, Rds(on) test condition and lead assignments (p8 'LEAD ASSIGNMENTS HEXFET 1-GATE 2-DRAIN 3-SOURCE', tab drain). Binding IRFZ44NSPbF by name as an explicit MOSFET alternative mirrors OHM-098 and does not touch the regulator default. Model: the authored IRFZ44N_R6 subcircuit (fit to the TO-220 IRFZ44N, same 55 V / 17.5 mOhm / 2-4 V Vth die rating set) is reused as an explicit proxy; the existing MOSFET probe checks it against the IRFZ44NS's own 17.5 mOhm maximum at VGS 10 V, ID 25 A.

recipe.template_provenance_note: Class MOSFET template (spec line 6003) with BVDSS bound to the sourced IRFZ44NS VDSS, identical in form to OHM-098.
limitations: Only IRFZ44NSPbF is bound; the L7805 D2PAK default (regulator), LM317/LM2940 and five-lead D2PAK variants are not substituted.
IRFZ44N_R6 was fitted to the TO-220 IRFZ44N sheet; it is used as a same-rating proxy and checked only at the IRFZ44NS Rds(on) test point.

Library D2PAK omits the cropped centre lead (pin 2, drain); the drain is reached through the tab. 94 W case power and 1.5 K/W imply different limits; the lower is enforced. Infineon web page 110 W/1.4 K/W is not adopted. Avalanche: only the 150 mJ thermally limited value is a ceiling; the 530 mJ typical destructive value is not an operating limit.

pin_map_evidence: IRFZ44NS/LPbF PD-95124 p8 'D2Pak Package Outline' (rendered, viewed): 'LEAD ASSIGNMENTS HEXFET 1.- GATE 2.- DRAIN 3.- SOURCE'; tab is the drain (recorded field manufacturer_pin_roles {1:G, 2:D, 3:S, tab:D}). Library PKG-D2PAK: pin1 (-2.54,-6.4), pin3 (+2.54,-6.4), tab pad (0,+3.3), cropped centre lead omitted by default. pin_role_fact pops the cropped lead '2' as a tied feature (its role D is present on 'tab'), leaving {1:G, 3:S, tab:D} = terminal_roles. The library's terminal label for the tab must be confirmed as 'tab' (if the library numbers it 4, use a manufacturer_to_package_terminal permutation tab->4 with provenance).
